PREVIEW_CACHE.TITLE: Preview data source
PREVIEW_CACHE.EXPLAIN_CACHED: This step was read back from an earlier preview instead of being recomputed. Cached data is reused only while the source and every earlier step are unchanged — editing any of them recomputes this step automatically.
PREVIEW_CACHE.EXPLAIN_FRESH: This step was computed for this preview and stored, so opening it again will not recompute it.
PREVIEW_CACHE.ALSO_DROPS: This also drops the {{count}} step(s) after it, because each one is computed from the previous step's output.
PREVIEW_CACHE.EXPLAIN_NOT_RUN: This step is carried out by an app, and a preview never starts a container. Until you run it, the table shows the rows going into the step rather than what it returns.

APP_TRANSFORMER.TITLE: App transformation
APP_TRANSFORMER.NOT_RUN_HINT: This step runs in an app, so the preview cannot compute it on its own. Run it to see what it returns — the result is kept, and the steps after it are previewed on top of it.
APP_TRANSFORMER.RUNNING_HINT: Step {{index}} is running in its app. Its result appears here as soon as the app answers.
APP_TRANSFORMER.BLOCKED_HINT: This step is previewed on rows that step {{index}} has not produced yet, because that step runs in an app. Run step {{index}} first — this one is then computed on its real input.
